goal: Get dispatch's confirmation of a replacement booking for DL-012 and the recipient's acknowledgement of the revised plan.

messages.body: DL-012 was due on 2026-02-12, 08:00–09:00 UTC. Vehicle fault V-12 ended that route at 08:20 on that day; the parcel is back in depot custody and was not delivered.
Yesterday’s booked window was missed and I still have no parcel. I am free on 2026-02-14 in the afternoon. Please arrange a replacement slot.
Please rebook DL-012 after the confirmed breakdown. Fenn can receive it on 2026-02-14 afternoon; confirm a specific available window and any charge.
Afternoon capacity on 2026-02-14 was filled at 09:30 UTC, before we reached your request. There is no rescheduling charge. Nothing is reserved yet.
